reference.question: How many integers \(n\) satisfy \(\sqrt{11}<n<\sqrt{90}\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Bracket the endpoints and list the integers

\(9<11<16\) gives \(3<\sqrt{11}<4\); \(81<90<100\) gives \(9<\sqrt{90}<10\). Thus, \(n\) can be \(4,5,6,7,8,9\), a total of \(6\) integers.
